# Halfway Anywhere

> > Halfway Anywhere is Tyler 'Mac' Fox's comprehensive resource for thru-hiking the Pacific Crest Trail and Continental Divide Trail, international trekking guides, and ultralight backpacking gear reviews.

The site features annual hiker surveys with data-driven insights from PCT, CDT, and JMT thru-hikers, detailed trekking guides for Nepal's Himalayas, New Zealand, Japan, and Tasmania, plus expert gear reviews focused on ultralight backpacking equipment. Mac combines personal trail experience with community survey data to create authoritative planning resources for long-distance hikers and adventure travelers.

## U.S. Long-Distance Trail Resources

- [The Ultimate Pacific Crest Trail Resource](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/pacific-crest-trail): Comprehensive PCT resource: 2,600mi Mexico-Canada trail guide & planning
- [The Ultimate Continental Divide Trail Resource](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/continental-divide-trail): Comprehensive CDT resource: 3,100mi Mexico-Canada trail guide & surveys
- [Pacific Crest Trail Survey](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/pacific-crest-trail-survey): Annual PCT hiker survey data on gear, resupply & thru-hiking strategies
- [The John Muir Trail Hiker Survey](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/john-muir-trail-survey): Annual JMT hiker survey data & statistics for trail planning

## Backpacking Gear Reviews & Guides

- [The Ultimate Backpacking Gear Resource](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear): Hub for thru-hiking & backpacking gear reviews, lists & buying guides
- [Best Shoes for Thru-Hiking in 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear/best-thru-hiking-shoes): Reviews Altra Lone Peak & top trail runners for PCT, CDT & long hikes
- [Best Satellite Messengers & PLBs for Thru-Hiking for 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear/best-satellite-messengers): Reviews Garmin inReach Mini 3, ACR ResQLink & satellite communication gear
- [Best Camping Sleeping Pads for 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear/best-camping-sleeping-pads): Reviews Therm-a-Rest NeoAir XLite & top sleeping pads for backpacking
- [The Best Backpacking Quilts for 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear/best-backpacking-quilts): Reviews Katabatic Flex, Enlightened Equipment & ultralight quilt systems
- [Best Merino Wool T-Shirts of 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/best-merino-wool-t-shirts): Reviews Ridge Merino, Patagonia, Icebreaker & other merino wool shirts
